scope.zh: 人工选取 12 个 Copilot Studio 路线图 ID、3 条发布公告与 1 条历史计划／现有文档对照；同名但 ID 不同的记录分别保留，ID 本身唯一，不代表完整目录或 16 项独立能力。
scope.en: A curated set of 12 Copilot Studio roadmap IDs, 3 release notices, and 1 archived-plan/current-documentation comparison. Same-title records with distinct IDs are retained; IDs are unique, and this is not an exhaustive list or 16 distinct capabilities.

limitations.zh: 只查询收录快照，不自动更新。Worldwide 标签不证明所有地区、语言、许可或租户可用；未检测客户环境。月份值保持 YYYY-MM，空日期表示收录来源未提供，不表示无需预览。
limitations.en: This queries only the included snapshot, without automatic refresh. Worldwide tags do not verify every region, language, license, or tenant. No customer environment was checked. YYYY-MM values retain month precision; missing dates mean not supplied by the collected sources.

dateFieldNote.zh: Learn 日期取自 ms.date 的 UTC 日期部分，不是页脚 Last updated；未采集 updated_at。计划月、公告月、核对日和路线图 modified 各自保留。
dateFieldNote.en: Learn dates use the UTC date portion of ms.date, not the footer's Last updated; updated_at is not collected. Planned months, notice months, verification dates, and roadmap modified remain separate.

title.zh: 新 harness 的原生网页浏览
title.en: Native Web Browsing on the New Harness

records.officialTitle: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness

summary.zh: 计划让新 harness 的 agent 原生浏览和操作网页、提取信息、下载文件，并与其他工具配合完成流程。
summary.en: Plans native website navigation, interaction, information extraction, and file downloads on the new harness, combined with other tools in a workflow.

summary.zh: 收录来源未确认这项原生浏览已经发布。Learn 对照表仍将 GitHub Copilot harness 的 Computer use 列为 Planned；standard harness 的 GA 公告不覆盖此范围。
summary.en: The collected sources do not confirm release of this native browsing capability. Learn still lists Computer use as Planned for the GitHub Copilot harness; the standard-harness GA notice does not cover this scope.

constraints.zh: 条目原文使用 Microsoft Copilot Harness；相关 Learn 文档使用 GitHub Copilot harness。保留原名，并核对你使用的运行时与具体工具形态。
constraints.en: The item says Microsoft Copilot Harness; the related Learn page says GitHub Copilot harness. Retain both names and verify the actual runtime and tool form you use.

constraints.zh: 条目只列 Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) 与 Web，没有给出具体语言、许可或客户租户推出结果。
constraints.en: Only Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant) and Web are listed; the item does not specify language, licensing, or rollout in a customer tenant.

selection.zh: 将其作为跟踪／试点候选；当前项目若必须依赖原生浏览，先验证可用替代路径，不把目标月份写成已交付承诺。
selection.en: Track it or plan a pilot. If native browsing is mandatory now, verify an available alternative rather than treating the target month as a delivered commitment.

title.en: Computer Use on the Standard Harness

summary.zh: standard harness 的工具在已配置 Windows 机器上，通过屏幕、虚拟鼠标和键盘操作网页及桌面应用。
summary.en: A standard-harness tool uses the screen, a virtual mouse, and a keyboard to automate websites and desktop apps on a configured Windows machine.

summary.zh: What's new 的 2026 年 5 月条目明确标为 General availability。这是该工具形态的发布依据，不证明新 harness 原生浏览或所有计算机操作方式都 GA。
summary.en: The May 2026 What's new entry explicitly says General availability. This substantiates this tool form, not native browsing on the new harness or every computer-use integration.

constraints.zh: 只适用于开启 generative orchestration 的 agent；需配置目标机器、连接和执行身份。共享 maker-provided credentials 的 agent 会让使用者按作者权限操作机器。
constraints.en: The agent must have generative orchestration enabled, with a machine, connection, and execution identity configured. Sharing maker-provided credentials lets users act with the author's machine access.

constraints.zh: standalone 工具另有 preview 文档，且目前只能用于 agent flows、不能用于 workflows；不要把本条 GA 扩大到它。
constraints.en: The standalone tool has separate preview documentation and can currently be used in agent flows, not workflows. Do not extend this GA label to it.

selection.zh: 可以进入当前方案验证；核验机器隔离、最小权限、目标渠道和业务动作，再决定生产依赖。
selection.en: It can enter current-solution validation. Verify machine isolation, least privilege, the target channel, and the business action before relying on it in production.

title.en: Dataverse as a Native Knowledge Source

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Dataverse integration on Copilot Studio

summary.zh: 把 Dataverse 业务表作为原生知识源，让 agent 用结构化企业数据回答问题。
summary.en: Uses Dataverse business tables as native knowledge sources for answers grounded in structured enterprise data.

summary.zh: 9 月 What's new 已列出 Dataverse tables，但没有给整个能力明确 GA 标签，并把 Multiline Text／File 的非结构化检索标为 preview。保留路线图仍为开发中的差异。
summary.en: September What's new lists Dataverse tables without an explicit overall GA label and calls unstructured retrieval over Multiline Text/File columns preview. The roadmap's In development state is retained.

constraints.zh: 必须启用 Dataverse search，使用 Authenticate with Microsoft，并具备底层数据权限；每个知识源最多 15 张表。
constraints.en: Requires Dataverse search, Authenticate with Microsoft, and underlying data permissions; each knowledge source supports up to 15 tables.

constraints.zh: 预览中的 Multiline Text／File 列需配置 Searchable 和 Quick Find View；先添加知识源再配置列，回填可能最多需要两天。
constraints.en: Preview Multiline Text/File retrieval requires Searchable columns and a Quick Find View. Adding the source before configuring columns can require up to two days of backfill.

selection.zh: 先验证结构化数据问答与权限，再单独决定是否依赖预览中的非结构化列；不能把计划 GA 月份当作全部范围已 GA。
selection.en: Validate structured answers and permissions first, then decide separately whether to depend on preview unstructured columns. The planned GA month does not establish GA for every scope.

title.en: Azure SQL and SQL Server Knowledge

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: SQL server Support in Microsoft Copilot Studio

summary.zh: 将 Azure SQL／SQL Server 中的表和视图加入知识源，以配置的连接与数据库权限读取结构化数据。
summary.en: Adds tables and views from Azure SQL/SQL Server as knowledge, reading structured data through the configured connection and database permissions.

summary.zh: 8 月 What's new 已列出 Azure SQL tables，现有 Learn 页面提供表／视图操作步骤，但收录材料没有明确 GA 标签。路线图仍标 In development，不据操作文档自动升级。
summary.en: August What's new lists Azure SQL tables and Learn documents table/view setup, but the collected material has no explicit GA label. The roadmap still says In development; setup guidance does not automatically upgrade it.

constraints.zh: Power Platform 必须能连接数据库；连接身份要能列出并读取所选表／视图，表需主键。文档明确答案受 maker 配置的连接与数据库权限限制。
constraints.en: Power Platform needs network reachability. The connection identity must list and read selected tables/views, and tables need primary keys. Answers are limited by the maker's configured connection and database permissions.

constraints.zh: 发布 agent 后在目标体验测试；文档建议先用返回已知小数据集的 diagnostic view，确认连接与问答结果。
constraints.en: Publish the agent and test in the target experience. Learn recommends a diagnostic view returning a small, known dataset to verify the connection and answers.

selection.zh: 可进入数据与身份验证；没有验证连接权限和发布后行为之前，不把菜单入口或计划月份写成可用保证。
selection.en: It can enter data and identity validation. Do not treat a menu entry or target month as an availability guarantee before testing permissions and published behavior.

title.zh: Maker 间的 agent 共享

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers

summary.zh: 路线图描述新 harness 的 maker 协作共享，包含 Agent Viewer 与 Editor 角色。
summary.en: The roadmap describes maker sharing on the new harness with Agent Viewer and Editor roles.

summary.zh: 官方路线图已标 Launched。但现有新分享文档说界面只给予 viewing rights，编辑需要其他角色路径；发布标记不消除具体操作范围的差异。
summary.en: The roadmap is marked Launched. The current new-sharing documentation nevertheless says the UI grants viewing rights, with other paths for editing; the release label does not resolve that operational difference.

constraints.zh: 现有文档要求 Authenticate with Microsoft、接收者的 Copilot Studio per-user license，以及相应 Teams + Microsoft 365 发布设置。
constraints.en: The current page requires Authenticate with Microsoft, a Copilot Studio per-user license for recipients, and the relevant Teams + Microsoft 365 publishing settings.

constraints.zh: 共享初始 agent 不会自动授予被调用 workflow 环境的访问权；新分享界面的查看权也不等于编辑权。
constraints.en: Sharing the initial agent does not grant access to a called workflow's environment, and viewing rights in the new sharing UI do not imply editing rights.

selection.zh: 若协作编辑是硬要求，分别测试查看、编辑、配置、分享和发布操作及其角色路径；不要只凭 Launched 标签验收。
selection.en: If collaborative editing is mandatory, test view, edit, configure, share, and publish operations with their role paths instead of accepting the Launched label alone.

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Conversational configuration of connectors in Copilot Studio

summary.zh: 通过聊天中的登录体验配置 agent 所需连接器，减少跳转到完整设置页面的需要。
summary.en: Configures the connectors an agent needs through in-chat sign-in rather than a full settings experience.

summary.zh: 官方标记为 Rolling out，说明推出在进行中；不是所有租户完成推出的证明，也不把 2026-09 目标月份改成精确上线日。
summary.en: The official label is Rolling out. It does not establish completion in all tenants or turn the September 2026 target into an exact launch day.

constraints.zh: 原始平台标签为 Desktop、Mac、Web；具体连接器、身份与策略的适用范围未在条目中逐项列明，需针对所需连接器核验。
constraints.en: The original platform tags are Desktop, Mac, and Web. The item does not enumerate connector-, identity-, or policy-specific scope, so verify the required connector separately.

selection.zh: 安排目标环境的配置试点；若入口尚未出现，保留现有配置路径，不能以推出中标记承诺全量可用。
selection.en: Pilot configuration in the target environment. If the entry is absent, retain the existing setup path rather than promising complete availability from the rollout label.

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio

summary.zh: 在构建体验中以 Review 提示显示策略、评估等可能阻碍发布的问题。
summary.en: Surfaces policy, evaluation, and other readiness issues through a Review indicator in the build experience.

summary.zh: 路线图标为 Launched。相关 Agent status 文档适用于 standard harness 且仍标 preview；不能将两者按相近名称统一成所有运行时已 GA。
summary.en: The roadmap says Launched. The related Agent status page is for the standard harness and still says preview; similar naming does not establish GA across all runtimes.

constraints.zh: Agent status 摘要不替代管理员治理或合规报告；实际阻塞项与 draft／published 状态需在相应体验中复核。
constraints.en: The Agent status summary does not replace admin governance or compliance reporting. Check actual blockers and draft/published state in the relevant experience.

selection.zh: 用它辅助发现配置问题，不把绿色状态或 Launched 标记当作完整合规／上线验收。
selection.en: Use it to help find configuration issues, not as a complete compliance or production acceptance certificate.

title.zh: 流程接入 MCP 工具

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Use MCP-compliant tools in agent workflows

summary.zh: MCP（Model Context Protocol）是连接 agent 与工具的协议；该条目描述在 agent workflows 中接入 MCP 工具、系统与动态知识来源。
summary.en: MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects agents with tools. This item describes MCP tools, systems, and dynamic knowledge in agent workflows.

summary.zh: 官方路线图已标 Launched。这里用此标记作为该条目的发布依据；Learn 的 inline agent 文档只证明其中一条 MCP 工具接入路径。
summary.en: The roadmap is marked Launched, which substantiates this item's release label. The inline-agent Learn page documents one MCP tool path, not every possible integration.

constraints.zh: 相关 workflow 文档支持在 inline agent 上附加 MCP server 工具；要区分这种接入、直接节点接入，以及把 workflow 当成 agent 工具的不同路径。
constraints.en: The related workflow page supports attaching MCP server tools to an inline agent. Distinguish that path from direct nodes and from adding a workflow as an agent tool.

selection.zh: 可启动目标接入路径验证；按需要的 MCP server、工具权限与输出要求验收，不把协议支持当作任何服务器均可用的保证。
selection.en: Validate the exact integration path, MCP server, permissions, and output requirements. Protocol support does not guarantee that every server will work.

title.zh: Agent node：已发布标记的记录

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node

summary.zh: 让流程中的 agent node 负责推理，再把结果交给后续步骤。它与 562222 有相同官方标题和计划月份。
summary.en: Uses an agent node for reasoning inside a flow, then passes its result to later steps. It shares the official title and planned months of 562222.

summary.zh: 566998 当前为 Launched，而同名 562222 为 In development。两个 ID 分别保留，不能把一个的发布状态覆盖到另一个。
summary.en: 566998 currently says Launched, while the same-title 562222 says In development. Both IDs are retained; one record's state does not overwrite the other.

constraints.zh: Learn 分别提供 standard agent flow 与 GitHub Copilot workflow 的节点文档。现有来源没有明确把这两个 ID 分别对应到两种运行时。
constraints.en: Learn has separate node pages for standard agent flows and GitHub Copilot workflows, but the collected sources do not explicitly map these two IDs to those runtimes.

constraints.zh: workflow 的 inline agent 与调用已发布 agent 是两种配置；应验证实际选择、输出字段与后续动作。
constraints.en: An inline workflow agent and a call to a published agent are distinct configurations. Verify the chosen path, output fields, and downstream action.

selection.zh: 以实际节点路径和同范围文档完成验证；在决策中保留同名条目差异，不把它解释成官方迁移或替代关系。
selection.en: Validate the actual node path against matching guidance. Keep the same-title discrepancy visible rather than inventing an official migration or replacement relationship.

title.zh: Agent node：仍开发中的同名记录
title.en: Agent Node: The Same-Title Development Record

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node

summary.zh: 流程节点内调用 agent 进行推理、工具调用与数据处理；与 566998 同名但状态不同。
summary.en: Calls an agent within a flow step for reasoning, tools, and data processing. Its title matches 566998 but its status differs.

summary.zh: 本 ID 仍为 In development，尽管 2026-09 GA 目标月份已过。同名 566998 的 Launched 标记不足以证明本 ID 的状态已改变。
summary.en: This ID remains In development despite the past September 2026 GA target. The Launched label on 566998 does not prove a state change for this ID.

constraints.zh: 不要按标题合并或自动选择较新 modified 值。两种 Learn 节点文档提供实施路径，但没有解释这两个路线图 ID 的归属差异。
constraints.en: Do not merge by title or automatically choose the newer modified timestamp. The two Learn node pages document implementation paths but do not explain ownership of these roadmap IDs.

selection.zh: 保留为待澄清的计划记录，按所需实际路径核验并向官方确认范围；不单凭过去的日期承诺已交付。
selection.en: Keep this plan record unresolved, verify the required implementation, and seek official scope clarification rather than promising delivery from a past date.

title.zh: Workflows 的 Computer use：取消条目
title.en: Computer Use in Workflows: Cancelled Item

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Supercharge your workflows with computer use

summary.zh: 原计划把 computer use 的 UI 自动化用于 workflows；条目已标 Cancelled，并说明内容不再准确、会从路线图移除。
summary.en: The item planned UI automation with computer use in workflows. It is now Cancelled and states that the item is no longer accurate and will be removed.

summary.zh: 官方更正原文：Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. 此说明针对该条目，不是整个 Computer use 能力的取消公告。
summary.en: The correction says: Update: This roadmap item is no longer accurate and will be removed from the roadmap. This concerns the item, not the whole Computer use capability.

constraints.zh: standard Computer use 另有 GA 公告；standalone 工具仍是 preview，且当前不能加入 workflows。新 harness 原生网页浏览也有独立计划。
constraints.en: Standard Computer use has a separate GA notice. The standalone tool remains preview and currently cannot be added to workflows; new-harness native browsing has its own plan.

selection.zh: 不要继续以旧条目日期承诺交付；保留更正记录，按实际工具形态选择替代路径。
selection.en: Do not keep committing to the old item's dates. Retain the correction and choose an alternative based on the actual tool form.

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Persistent identity for Copilot Studio Agents

summary.zh: 计划让 agent 具备独立账户、邮箱、Teams presence 与 Office 访问，参与跨团队业务协作，并由管理员治理。
summary.en: Plans agent accounts with their own mailbox, Teams presence, and Office access for governed collaborative business processes.

summary.zh: 本条仍为 In development。已存在的 Entra Agent ID 文档说明身份治理，不是独立邮箱／Teams／Office 能力已经交付的证据。
summary.en: This item remains In development. Existing Entra Agent ID guidance describes identity governance, not evidence that mailbox, Teams, and Office capabilities have shipped.

constraints.zh: 要区分 Entra Agent ID 的治理／连接器权限与本条独立协作账户范围；该条目没有提供具体许可或租户启用细节。
constraints.en: Distinguish Entra Agent ID governance/connector permissions from this collaborative-account scope. The item provides no detailed licensing or tenant enablement conditions.

selection.zh: 若业务需要 agent 自有邮箱，单独核验本条能力；不能把已有 Agent ID 当成该要求已经满足。
selection.en: If the process requires an agent-owned mailbox, validate this capability separately; an existing Agent ID does not satisfy that requirement by itself.

title.zh: 受 MPIP 保护的敏感文件

records.officialTitle: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)

summary.zh: 计划在 M365 渠道支持上传带 Microsoft Purview Information Protection（MPIP）敏感度标签的文件，按用户／agent 权限处理并执行标签保护。
summary.en: Plans uploads of files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels on the M365 channel, processed under user/agent permissions with label protections enforced.

summary.zh: 预览和 GA 目标月份均为 2026-10，但官方状态仍为 In development；收录来源没有确认该受保护文件范围已发布。
summary.en: Both preview and GA targets are October 2026, but the official state remains In development. The collected sources do not confirm release of this protected-file scope.

constraints.zh: 原文限定 M365 channel、权限与标签保护。普通文件上传已有公告，不足以证明 MPIP 保护范围同样可用。
constraints.en: The item specifies the M365 channel, permissions, and label protection. A notice for ordinary file uploads does not establish the same availability for MPIP-protected files.

selection.zh: 对带标签的代表性测试文件单独核验授权和拒绝行为；未确认前不将此范围写成已交付。
selection.en: Test authorization and denial using representative labeled files. Do not claim this scope as delivered until it is verified.

title.zh: REST API 自动运行 agent 评估
title.en: Automated Agent Evaluations via REST API

records.officialTitle: automated agent evaluations from a REST API

summary.zh: 通过 Power Platform REST API 触发已创建 test set 的评估，并用运行 ID 取得异步结果，便于接入回归验证。
summary.en: Uses the Power Platform REST API to trigger an existing test set and retrieve asynchronous results by run ID for regression workflows.

summary.zh: 2026 年 4 月 What's new 对此项明确标 Preview。相关 API 文档没有给出此项后来 GA 的明确公告；收录快照继续保留原始预览标签。
summary.en: April 2026 What's new explicitly labels this Preview. The related API guidance does not provide a later explicit GA notice for this capability; the original preview label is retained.

constraints.zh: 文档适用 standard harness，需要目标 Bot／Environment ID、已有 test set、具备相应权限的 Microsoft Entra 用户访问令牌。本站没有执行这些调用。
constraints.en: The page applies to the standard harness and requires target Bot/Environment IDs, an existing test set, and a suitably authorized Microsoft Entra user token. This site has not made these calls.

selection.zh: 可以安排授权测试环境中的评估自动化试点；不要把评估总体的 GA 状态扩大为每个自动化接口都 GA。
selection.en: Pilot evaluation automation in an authorized test environment. Do not extend GA for evaluations generally to every automation interface.

title.zh: GitHub Copilot harness 新构建体验
title.en: The GitHub Copilot Harness Authoring Experience

records.officialTitle: Use the new experience in Copilot Studio to build agents

summary.zh: 新的构建与运行时体验通过 Instructions、Knowledge、Tools、Skills 等组件配置 agent，与 standard harness 并存。
summary.en: The redesigned authoring/runtime experience configures agents through Instructions, Knowledge, Tools, Skills, and other components alongside the standard harness.

summary.zh: 6 月公告使用 Production-ready preview 原始标签，本页不把它归为 GA，也不据一般介绍页推定后来全体 GA。具体组件可能各有不同状态。
summary.en: The June notice uses the original Production-ready preview label. This page does not normalize it to GA or infer later whole-harness GA from an overview. Individual components can have different states.

constraints.zh: harness 是模型调用与工具执行的运行时，不是 GitHub Copilot 服务；能力、发布渠道、身份和计费应按对应 harness 文档核验。
constraints.en: A harness is the runtime for model and tool calls, not the GitHub Copilot service. Check capabilities, channels, identity, and billing against matching harness guidance.

constraints.zh: 相关功能对照仍把新 harness 的 Computer use 列为 Planned，说明整体验收不能用单一标签代替组件级核验。
constraints.en: The feature comparison still lists Computer use as Planned on the new harness, so a single overall label cannot replace component-specific validation.

selection.zh: 保留原始预览限定，为所需组件逐项验证适用条款与生产条件；不把 Production-ready preview 改写成所有能力均 GA。
selection.en: Retain the original preview qualification and verify terms and production conditions for each required component. Production-ready preview does not mean every capability is GA.

title.zh: IP firewall：历史 GA 日期与预览文档
title.en: IP Firewall: Archived GA Date and Preview Guidance

records.officialTitle: Extend IP firewall to Microsoft Copilot Studio

summary.zh: 限制从未批准 IP／地址范围访问 Copilot Studio 和 agent 的入站请求；历史计划列有预览与 GA 日期。
summary.en: Restricts inbound access to Copilot Studio and agents from unapproved IP ranges; an archived plan supplies preview and GA date cells.

summary.zh: 归档计划原文：Public preview Jul 14, 2025；General availability Dec 12, 2025。现有产品文档仍明确标为 preview，未用过去的计划日期确认 GA 交付。
summary.en: The archived plan says Public preview Jul 14, 2025 and General availability Dec 12, 2025. The current capability page still explicitly says preview; the past date is not used to confirm GA delivery.

constraints.zh: 需要 Managed Environment 和相应管理员角色。现有文档明确说明 preview 不用于生产且可能功能受限。
constraints.en: Requires a Managed Environment and an appropriate admin role. The current documentation explicitly says preview features are not meant for production and can be restricted.

constraints.zh: 限制不在 Teams／Microsoft Copilot、Facebook 或 Dynamics 365 Customer Service 渠道执行；现有会话要重启后才受新限制影响。
constraints.en: Restrictions are not enforced on Teams/Microsoft Copilot, Facebook, or Dynamics 365 Customer Service channels; existing sessions need restarting before new restrictions apply.

selection.zh: 若全渠道 IP 强制隔离是硬要求，不以此能力作为唯一控制；需按当前文档范围和官方澄清决定试点或其他控制。
selection.en: If mandatory IP isolation across all channels is required, do not use this as the sole control. Base a pilot or alternative controls on current documented scope and official clarification.
